test_eigen_fixed_dense_matrices: test pybind11 Eigen fixed and dense matrix bindings with numpy arrays for row and column major layouts
test_eigen_mutator_descriptors: test Eigen matrix mutator descriptors that enforce numpy array shape, writability, and contiguity constraints
test_eigen_cpp_casting: test C++ casting of numpy arrays to Eigen matrices and back via pybind11 type casters
test_eigen_return_references: test returning Eigen matrix references, views, copies, and blocks from C++ to Python with proper ownership semantics
test_eigen_sparse_matrices: test pybind11 Eigen sparse matrix bindings with scipy CSR and CSC sparse matrix formats
